name: controlflow-codex
description: Explicit native Codex reliability layer: adaptive task contracts, captured evidence, completion gates, and bounded lifecycle hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Explicit repository work with current evidence
interface.longDescription: ControlFlow uses V4 for new tasks: risk-aware planning artifacts, manual decision provenance, source-bound QA/review packets and quality reports. Existing V3 runs retain explicit legacy semantics. Native Codex owns tools, permissions and agent lifecycle. Candidate package; verified human receipts and complete comparative telemetry remain unavailable; platform and host evidence is source/version specific.
defaultPrompt: Use $controlflow-codex:controlflow to complete this repository task with appropriate evidence.
Use $controlflow-codex:controlflow-plan to persist a saved contract after native planning.
